passage.text: Should university education be free for everyone?
passage.reading: ʃʊd ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˌɛdʒəˈkeɪʃən bi ˈfriː fər ˈɛvriwʌn?

passage.text: Last week, students at our university had a debate about this question.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈwiːk, ˈstuːdənts ət aʊr ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈhæd ə dɪˈbeɪt əˈbaʊt ðɪs ˈkwɛstʃən.

passage.text: In some countries, university is free or almost free.
passage.reading: ɪn sʌm ˈkʌntriz, ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪz ˈfriː ɔːr ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈfriː.

passage.text: In Thailand, however, most students have to pay tuition.
passage.reading: ɪn ˈtaɪlænd, haʊˈɛvər, ˈmoʊst ˈstuːdənts ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ tuˈɪʃən.

passage.text: We asked two students for their points of view.
passage.reading: wiː ˈæskt ˈtuː ˈstuːdənts fər ðɛr ˈpɔɪnts əv ˈvjuː.

passage.text: Nam, a fourth-year English student, believes that education should be free.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm, ə ˌfɔːrθ ˌjɪr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈstuːdənt, bɪˈliːvz ðæt ˌɛdʒəˈkeɪʃən ʃʊd bi ˈfriː.

passage.text: "Everyone should have equal access to education, whether they are rich or poor," she says.
passage.reading: ˈɛvriwʌn ʃʊd ˈhæv ˈiːkwəl ˈæksɛs tə ˌɛdʒəˈkeɪʃən, ˈwɛðər ðeɪ ər ˈrɪtʃ ɔːr ˈpʊr, ʃiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "Many smart students from the countryside can't afford the fees, so they never go to university."
passage.reading: ˈmɛni ˈsmɑːrt ˈstuːdənts frəm ðə ˈkʌntrisaɪd ˈkænt əˈfɔːrd ðə ˈfiːz, soʊ ðeɪ ˈnɛvər ˈɡoʊ tə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

passage.text: She also believes that free education is good for the country.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈɔːlsoʊ bɪˈliːvz ðæt ˈfriː ˌɛdʒəˈkeɪʃən ɪz ˈɡʊd fər ðə ˈkʌntri.

passage.text: "Graduates earn more, so they pay more tax later. In other words, the country gets its money back."
passage.reading: ˈɡrædʒuəts ˈɜːrn ˈmɔːr, soʊ ðeɪ ˈpeɪ ˈmɔːr ˈtæks ˈleɪtər. ɪn ˈʌðər ˈwɜːrdz, ðə ˈkʌntri ˈɡɛts ɪts ˈmʌni ˈbæk.

passage.text: "Of course I want equal access for everyone, but free education isn't really free," she explains.
passage.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs aɪ ˈwɑːnt ˈiːkwəl ˈæksɛs fər ˈɛvriwʌn, bʌt ˈfriː ˌɛdʒəˈkeɪʃən ˈɪzənt ˈriːli ˈfriː, ʃiː ɪkˈspleɪnz.

passage.text: "Someone has to pay for it, and the money comes from taxes."
passage.reading: ˈsʌmwʌn ˈhæs tə ˈpeɪ fər ɪt, ənd ðə ˈmʌni ˈkʌmz frəm ˈtæksɪz.

passage.text: "As far as I'm concerned, families who can afford it should pay, and the government should help poor students with scholarships."
passage.reading: əz ˈfɑːr əz aɪm kənˈsɜːrnd, ˈfæməliz huː kən əˈfɔːrd ɪt ʃʊd ˈpeɪ, ənd ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ʃʊd ˈhɛlp ˈpʊr ˈstuːdənts wɪð ˈskɑːlərʃɪps.

passage.text: Both students agree on one thing: money should not stop talented young people from studying.
passage.reading: ˈboʊθ ˈstuːdənts əˈɡriː ɑːn ˈwʌn ˈθɪŋ: ˈmʌni ʃʊd ˈnɑːt ˈstɑːp ˈtæləntɪd ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl frəm ˈstʌdiɪŋ.

passage.text: What do you think? Send your opinion to our student magazine!
passage.reading: ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk? ˈsɛnd jʊr əˈpɪnjən tə aʊr ˈstuːdənt ˌmæɡəˈziːn!
